details.description:
Boost is one of India’s leading malt-based foods, fortified
with a combination of micronutrients that are essential for oxygen utilisation
in the body and energy metabolism. Boost is clinically proven to increase
stamina by 3 times (3X). Enjoyed by some of your favourite cricket superstars
across India, the delicious chocolate Boost drink can be prepared with hot or
cold milk and is fortified with 17 essential vitamins and minerals.
Boost is a nourishing beverage that helps build stamina and
contains nutrients which support the maintenance of optimal bone and muscle
strength. It is enriched with Envita Nutrients (Iron, Vitamin A, C, Folic Acid,
B12, and B6). Envita Nutrients help transport oxygen more effectively in the
body.
Nutrients present in Boost nourish the body in multiple
ways:
Iron and Vitamin C – help in the effective transportation of oxygen to muscles.
Vitamin B12, B2, B6, and Folic Acid – help muscles produce more energy in the
presence of oxygen.
Vitamin D, Calcium, and Protein – help maintain optimal bone and muscle
strength.
Vitamin B1, Niacin, Biotin, Pantothenic Acid, Iodine, and Magnesium – are
energy-releasing nutrients that help release energy from food.

details.description:
Boost now has protein, give your day a powerful start with Boost Protein, a nourishing drink mix formulated to support energy, strength, and stamina. With 2X protein compared to regular Boost* and a scientifically designed blend of high-performance nutrients, it helps you meet the demands of an active lifestyle.
Each 100g serving provides 15g protein, helping support muscle maintenance and recovery. It delivers 370 kcal, along with essential vitamins and minerals like Vitamins A, C, D2, B-complex, Calcium, Iron, and Zinc — key players in immune support, energy metabolism, and bone health. Uniquely, it contains no added sugar, making it a smart choice for health-conscious individuals.
Boost Protein also includes 2X stamina nutrients and 2X strength nutrients — a creative rendition of nutrients that support endurance, energy release, and normal muscle function. Whether you’re starting your day, recovering post-workout, or just need a nutritious pick-me-up, Boost Protein is designed to complement your regular diet and exercise plan.
Perfect for young adults, fitness enthusiasts, or anyone looking to stay energized and nourished. Boost Protein complements your regular diet and exercise plan without compromising on taste or nutrition.
Delicious, powerful, and easy to prepare – just mix with milk or water and unlock your inner strength.

details.description:
Boost, the secret to your energy, is now available in an exciting new pack. Enjoyed by some of your favourite cricket superstars all over India, Boost Milkshake is fortified with energy-releasing and stamina-supporting nutrients.
Boost MILKSHAKE from the house of BOOST is primarily made with Toned milk, cereal product, and essential micronutrients. It is scientifically designed blend of nutrients like vitamins, minerals, protein carbohydrate, so that you receive the vital elements that are required for your daily needs alongside your regular diet. It also contains protein and micronutrients that play a pivotal role in energy release & support stamina.
Nutrients such as Vitamin B1, B3, B6, B9 helps in releasing energy from food while Vitamin B6 and B9 also play a major role in reduction of tiredness. Apart from the above function Vitamin B9 contributes to normal blood formation. Boost milkshake contains combination of nutrients such as Calcium, Protein, zinc known to help in maintenance of normal bones and muscle function. This product is Trans Fat free and contains high protein. Hence, it is is a nourishing beverage to be consumed alongside your daily diet and exercise plan. The product tastes the best when chilled and comes in convenient packaging.

details.description: Boost Milkshake, the new secret to your energy, is a nourishing and tasty beverage. Now available in a convenient new pack, Boost Milkshake is enjoyed by sports enthusiasts across India with energy releasing and stamina supporting nutrients. Boost Milkshake from the house of Boost is made primarily with toned milk, cereal ingredients, and essential micronutrients. It contains a scientific blend of nutrients including carbohydrates, protein, vitamins, and minerals that help provide energy and support stamina when consumed alongside a regular diet for everyday consumption. The formulation includes important B-complex vitamins such as Vitamin B1, B3, B6, and B9, which help release energy from food. Vitamins B6 and B9 also contribute to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue, while Vitamin B9 supports normal blood formation. Boost Milkshake also contains calcium, protein, and zinc, which help support the maintenance of normal bones and muscle function. The product is trans fat free and contains high protein, making it a wholesome beverage option for active individuals. Boost Milkshake tastes best when served chilled and comes in easy-to-carry packaging, making it suitable for consumption at home or on the go. Enjoy it as part of a balanced diet and active lifestyle for everyday energy and stamina support.

details.description: Boost Milkshake, the new secret to your energy, now comes in a deliciously indulgent Caramel Milkshake variant. Made with toned milk, cereal extracts, and essential micronutrients, Boost Caramel Milkshake offers a scientifically balanced blend of protein, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals to support an active lifestyle and complement your daily diet. Best served chilled, it comes in a convenient, easy-to-carry pack - ideal for school, sports, or on-the-go consumption. With its irresistible caramel flavour and functional nutrition, Boost Milkshake perfectly blends taste and performance. Now introducing Boost Milkshake in a new exciting flavour - Caramel. Boost Milkshake is the new secret to your energy.
